context: Two friends chat about hobbies and travel
purpose: Teach: 魅了/足らず/斜面/淡路/崖/持ち上げ/高温/ひき

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、最近、彼の優しさに、本当に、魅了されてるんだ、私。
lines.en: Aoi — lately, I've been so captivated by how kind he is.
lines.style: Vulnerable admission, spoken almost to herself. Warm but guarded. Soft attack, trailing off slightly as if catching herself being honest.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。睡眠時間、足らずに、もう、ヘトヘトよ、私、最近、本当に。
lines.en: Yeah. I haven't been sleeping enough — I'm completely wiped out lately, honestly.
lines.style: Self-deprecating laugh underneath the words. Wry but not bitter. Matter-of-fact delivery with a hint of exhaustion sitting behind it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: スキー旅行、行ったとき、急な斜面、ちょっと、怖かったわよ。
lines.en: When we went on that ski trip, the steep slopes kind of scared me.
lines.style: Soft, almost vulnerable memory. Hesitant — she's admitting something she didn't say at the time. Gentle pace, reflective distance.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 夏休み、淡路島、旅行、計画してるんだ、玉ねぎ、美味しいよ。
lines.en: I'm planning a summer trip to Awaji Island — the onions there are incredible.
lines.style: Brightening energy, genuine enthusiasm breaking through. Conversational and warm. A small pivot toward something lighter, something shared.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 江ノ島、崖から、海の眺め、絶景だったよね、葵、覚えてる?
lines.en: Do you remember Enoshima? That view from the cliffs out over the ocean — it was breathtaking.
lines.style: Nostalgic, reaching back. Soft opening, gentle questioning tone. Seeking connection through a shared memory. Slight wistfulness on the trailing question.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: お重い荷物、持ち上げる時、腰、本当に、注意して、メイちゃん。
lines.en: When you're lifting those heavy bags, really take care with your back, okay Mei?
lines.style: Genuine concern, protective without being fussy. Steady, direct eye-contact level warmth. A small moment of care slipped into the conversation naturally.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 最近、高温多湿で、湿気、すごいね、洗濯物、乾きにくいよね。
lines.en: It's been so hot and humid lately — the moisture is ridiculous, and laundry just won't dry.
lines.style: Light complaint with self-aware humor. Wry acceptance of the season. Conversational pace, the kind of observation you share when sitting with someone.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: お肉、ひき肉に、変えた料理、結構、ヘルシーで、いいよね、最近、はまってる。
lines.en: I switched to ground meat for my cooking lately, and it's actually pretty healthy — I'm kind of obsessed with it.
lines.style: Genuine enjoyment and discovery. Warm, open sharing. Upbeat closer with real conviction behind the admission. Ends on a note of small pride.
